items.source: The full signature of the data type of the property (for example, String) but also a full generic type (such as java.util.Map<java.lang.String,com.example.MyEnum>). You can use this attribute to guide the user as to the types of values that they can enter. For consistency, the type of a primitive is specified by using its wrapper counterpart (for example, boolean becomes Boolean). Note that this class may be a complex type that gets converted from a String as values are bound. If the type is not known, it may be omitted.
items.translation: 属性数据类型的完整签名（例如，String），同时也包括完整的泛型类型（如 java.util.Map<java.lang.String,com.example.MyEnum>）。 您可以使用此属性来指导用户输入值的类型。 为了保持一致性，基本类型的类型应通过其包装器对应项指定（例如，boolean 变为 Boolean）。 请注意，此类型可能是一个复杂类型，在绑定值时从 String 转换而来。 如果类型未知，可以省略它。

items.source: The “hints” are additional information used to assist the user in configuring a given property. For example, when a developer is configuring the spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto property, a tool can use the hints to offer some auto-completion help for the none, validate, update, create, and create-drop values.
items.translation: “提示”是用于协助用户配置特定属性的附加信息。例如，当开发人员正在配置 spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto` 属性时，工具可以使用这些提示为 none`、validate`、update`、create` 和 create-drop 值提供自动完成帮助。

items.source: The class name of the source that contributed this group. For example, if the group were based on a @Bean method annotated with @ConfigurationProperties, this attribute would contain the fully qualified name of the @Configuration class that contains the method. If the source type is not known, the attribute may be omitted.
items.translation: 贡献该组的源类的类名。 例如，如果该组基于一个带有 @ConfigurationProperties 注解的 @Bean 方法，则该属性将包含包含该方法的 @Configuration 类的完全限定名。 如果源类型未知，则可以省略该属性。

items.source: The full name of the property to which this hint refers. Names are in lower-case period-separated form (such as spring.mvc.servlet.path). If the property refers to a map (such as system.contexts), the hint either applies to the keys of the map (system.contexts.keys) or the values (system.contexts.values) of the map. This attribute is mandatory.
items.translation: 该提示所引用的属性的完整名称。 名称采用小写点分隔形式（例如 spring.mvc.servlet.path`）。 如果该属性引用一个 Map（例如 system.contexts`），则该提示适用于该 Map 的 键（system.contexts.keys`）或 值（system.contexts.values）。 此属性为必选。

items.source: The preceding code makes sure that the deprecated property still works (delegating to the name property behind the scenes). Once the getTarget and setTarget methods can be removed from your public API, the automatic deprecation hint in the metadata goes away as well. If you want to keep a hint, adding manual metadata with an error deprecation level ensures that users are still informed about that property. Doing so is particularly useful when a replacement is provided.
items.translation: 前面的代码确保弃用的属性仍然有效（在幕后委托给 name` 属性）。 一旦可以从公共 API 中移除 getTarget` 和 setTarget` 方法，元数据中的自动弃用提示也会随之消失。 如果您希望保留提示，可以添加带有 error` 弃用级别的手动元数据，以确保用户仍会收到关于该属性的通知。 这样做在提供 replacement 时尤其有用。

items.source: Each “property” is a configuration item that the user specifies with a given value. For example, server.port and server.address might be specified in your application.properties/application.yaml, as follows:
items.translation: 每个“属性”都是一个用户指定给定值的配置项。例如，server.port 和 server.address 可能会在您的 application.properties/application.yaml 中指定如下：

items.source: The class name of the data type of the group. For example, if the group were based on a class annotated with @ConfigurationProperties, the attribute would contain the fully qualified name of that class. If it were based on a @Bean method, it would be the return type of that method. If the type is not known, the attribute may be omitted.
items.translation: 组数据类型的类名。 例如，如果该组基于一个带有 @ConfigurationProperties 注解的类，则该属性将包含该类的全限定名。 如果它基于一个 @Bean 方法，则将是该方法的返回类型。 如果类型未知，则可以省略该属性。

items.source: The full name of the method (include parenthesis and argument types) that contributed this group (for example, the name of a @ConfigurationProperties annotated @Bean method). If the source method is not known, it may be omitted.
items.translation: 贡献该组的完整方法名称（包括括号和参数类型）（例如，一个带有 @ConfigurationProperties 注解的 @Bean 方法）。 如果源方法未知，可以省略。

items.source: The level of deprecation, which can be either warning (the default) or error. When a property has a warning deprecation level, it should still be bound in the environment. However, when it has an error deprecation level, the property is no longer managed and is not bound.
items.translation: 弃用级别可以是 <code>warning`（默认值）或 <code>error`。当属性的弃用级别为 <code>warning` 时，它仍应在环境中绑定。然而，当其弃用级别为 <code>error` 时，该属性不再受管理且不会进行绑定。

items.source: Deprecation can also be specified declaratively in code by adding the @DeprecatedConfigurationProperty annotation to the getter exposing the deprecated property. For instance, assume that the my.app.target property was confusing and was renamed to my.app.name. The following example shows how to handle that situation:
items.translation: 弃注也可以通过在代码中声明方式指定，只需将 @DeprecatedConfigurationProperty 注解添加到暴露弃注属性的 getter 方法上。 例如，假设 my.app.target 属性令人困惑，并已重命名为 my.app.name。 以下示例展示了如何处理这种情况：

items.source: The “groups” are higher level items that do not themselves specify a value but instead provide a contextual grouping for properties. For example, the server.port and server.address properties are part of the server group.
items.translation: “组”是更高级别的项目，它们本身不指定值，而是为属性提供上下文分组。例如，`server.port` 和 `server.address` 属性属于 server 组。

items.source: The class name of the source that contributed this property. For example, if the property were from a class annotated with @ConfigurationProperties, this attribute would contain the fully qualified name of that class. If the source type is unknown, it may be omitted.
items.translation: 贡献此属性的源类的类名。 例如，如果该属性来自一个带有 @ConfigurationProperties 注解的类，则该属性将包含该类的全限定名。 如果源类型未知，则可以省略它。

items.source: The JSON object contained in the deprecation attribute of each properties element can contain the following attributes:
items.translation: deprecation 属性中包含的 JSON 对象可以包含以下属性：

items.source: The JSON object contained in the values attribute of each hint element can contain the attributes described in the following table:
items.translation: 每个 `` 元素的 values 属性中包含的 JSON 对象可以包含下表中描述的属性：

items.source: The JSON object contained in the providers attribute of each hint element can contain the attributes described in the following table:
items.translation: 每个 `` 元素的 providers 属性中包含的 JSON 对象可以包含下表中描述的属性：

items.source: The JSON object contained in the properties attribute of each ignored element can contain the attributes described in the following table:
items.translation: 每个 `` 元素的 properties 属性中包含的 JSON 对象可以包含下表中描述的属性：

items.source: Configuration metadata files are located inside jars under META-INF/spring-configuration-metadata.json. They use a JSON format with items categorized under either “groups” or “properties”, additional values hints categorized under “hints”, and ignored items under “ignored” as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 配置元数据文件位于 jar 包内的 META-INF/spring-configuration-metadata.json 中。它们使用 JSON 格式，其中项目分为“groups”或“properties”，附加值提示分为“hints”，忽略的项目分为“ignored”，如下例所示：

items.source: Finally, “ignored” is for items which have been deliberately ignored. The content of this section usually comes from the additional metadata.
items.translation: 最后，“ignored”用于那些被故意忽略的项目。本节的内容通常来自附加元数据。

items.source: The JSON object contained in the groups array can contain the attributes shown in the following table:
items.translation: groups 数组中包含的 JSON 对象可以包含如下表所示的属性：

items.source: A short description of the group that can be displayed to users. If no description is available, it may be omitted. It is recommended that descriptions be short paragraphs, with the first line providing a concise summary. The last line in the description should end with a period (.).
items.translation: 可显示给用户的组简短描述。如果不可用，可以省略该描述。建议描述为简短段落，第一行提供简洁摘要。描述最后一行应以句号（.）结尾。

items.source: The JSON object contained in the properties array can contain the attributes described in the following table:
items.translation: properties 数组中包含的 JSON 对象可以包含下表中描述的属性：

items.source: The full name of the property. Names are in lower-case period-separated form (for example, server.address). This attribute is mandatory.
items.translation: 属性的完整名称。 名称采用小写点分隔形式（例如，server.address）。 此属性为必选。

items.source: A short description of the property that can be displayed to users. If no description is available, it may be omitted. It is recommended that descriptions be short paragraphs, with the first line providing a concise summary. The last line in the description should end with a period (.).
items.translation: 可显示给用户的属性简短描述。如果不可用，可以省略该描述。建议描述为简短段落，第一行提供简洁的摘要。描述最后一行应以句号（.）结尾。

items.source: Specify whether the property is deprecated. If the field is not deprecated or if that information is not known, it may be omitted. The next table offers more detail about the deprecation attribute.
items.translation: 指定该属性是否已弃用。 如果该字段未弃用或未知此信息，则可以省略。 下表提供了有关 deprecation` 属性的更多详细信息。

items.source: A short description of the reason why the property was deprecated. If no reason is available, it may be omitted. It is recommended that descriptions be short paragraphs, with the first line providing a concise summary. The last line in the description should end with a period (.).
items.translation: 描述属性弃用的原因。如果无法提供原因，可以省略。建议描述为简短段落，第一行提供简洁的摘要。描述的最后一行应以句号（.）结尾。

items.source: The full name of the property that replaces this deprecated property. If there is no replacement for this property, it may be omitted.
items.translation: 替换此已弃用属性的完整属性名称。如果该属性没有替代项，则可以省略它。

items.source: The JSON object contained in the hints array can contain the attributes shown in the following table:
items.translation: hints 数组中包含的 JSON 对象可以包含如下表所示的属性：

items.source: A list of valid values as defined by the ValueHint object (described in the next table). Each entry defines the value and may have a description.
items.translation: 由 ValueHint` 对象（在下表中描述）定义的合法值列表。每个条目定义一个值，并可能包含描述。

items.source: A list of providers as defined by the ValueProvider object (described later in this document). Each entry defines the name of the provider and its parameters, if any.
items.translation: 由 ValueProvider` 对象（本文档稍后描述）定义的一组提供者。每个条目定义了提供者的名称及其参数（如果有）。

items.source: A short description of the value that can be displayed to users. If no description is available, it may be omitted. It is recommended that descriptions be short paragraphs, with the first line providing a concise summary. The last line in the description should end with a period (.).
items.translation: 可显示给用户的值的简短描述。如果不可用，可以省略该描述。建议描述为简短段落，第一行提供简洁的摘要。描述的最后一行应以句号（.）结尾。

items.source: The ignored object can contain the attributes shown in the following table:
items.translation: ignored 对象可以包含如下表中所示的属性：

items.source: The full name of the property to ignore. Names are in lower-case period-separated form (such as spring.mvc.servlet.path). This attribute is mandatory.
items.translation: 要忽略的属性全名。名称采用小写点分隔形式（例如 spring.mvc.servlet.path）。此属性为必选属性。

items.source:
The full name of the group.
  This attribute is mandatory.
items.translation:
组的全名。
此属性为必填项。

items.source:
The default value, which is used if the property is not specified.
  If the type of the property is an array, it can be an array of value(s).
  If the default value is unknown, it may be omitted.
items.translation: 默认值，当未指定属性时使用。如果属性的类型为数组，它可以是值（或多个值）的数组。如果默认值未知，可以省略它。

items.source:
The version in which the property became deprecated.
  Can be omitted.
items.translation:
该属性被弃用的版本。
可以省略。

items.source:
A valid value for the element to which the hint refers.
  If the type of the property is an array, it can also be an array of value(s).
  This attribute is mandatory.
items.translation: 提示所引用的元素的合法值。如果该属性的类型为数组，则也可以是一个或多个值的数组。此属性是必需的。

items.source: The name of the provider to use to offer additional content assistance for the element to which the hint refers.
items.translation: 用于为提示所引用的元素提供额外内容辅助的提供者名称。

items.source: JSON object
items.translation: JSON 对象

items.source: Any additional parameter that the provider supports (check the documentation of the provider for more details).
items.translation: 任何提供者支持的额外参数（有关详细信息，请查看提供者的文档）。

items.source: A list of ignored properties as defined by the ItemIgnore object (described in the next table). Each entry defines the name of the ignored property.
items.translation: 由 ItemIgnore 对象（在下表中描述）定义的忽略属性列表。每个条目定义了一个被忽略属性的名称。

items.source:
Objects with the same “property” and “group” name can appear multiple times within a metadata file.
For example, you could bind two separate classes to the same prefix, with each having potentially overlapping property names.
While the same names appearing in the metadata multiple times should not be common, consumers of metadata should take care to ensure that they support it.
items.translation: 具有相同“属性”和“组”名称的对象可以在元数据文件中出现多次。例如，您可以将两个不同的类绑定到同一个前缀，每个类可能具有重叠的属性名称。虽然元数据中出现重复名称的情况并不常见，但元数据的消费者应确保支持这种情况。
